title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-13 03:02:31 最新章节：第157章 阴煞冥火银月狼族的机会
content_zh:
新历631年，三月。
龙舒城，第一人民医院。
手术室内。
“好难受！”
脑子昏昏沉沉，像是喝多了假酒。
迷迷糊糊地睁眼，一个戴着金丝眼镜的秃顶男人面孔粗暴地闯入眼帘。
“年轻的小伙子，恭喜你！给你进行的速成地仙法手术很成功，熬过了麻烦的融合阶段，现在的你已经是一个踏入地仙道修行的菜鸟修士了！”
秃顶男人嘴角微翘，语气带着几分轻松。
成功做完一单手术，手术费到手，他的心情相当愉悦。
“速成法，地仙，成功了……”
刚刚醒来的陆羽懵逼地念叨着这几个词语，说着说着，迷茫的双眼里慢慢亮起明亮的光。
“我，道爷，我成了！”
喜悦涌上心头，脑子逐渐清醒，陆羽也想起了之前的一切。
前世陆羽是个普通人，一次救人的善举，让他被路过的泥头车碾成碎片。
带着前世的记忆，他转世重生到这方可以修仙的超凡世界，算是胎穿穿越者。
重活二十四年，因为没有修仙天赋，即便每日勤学不辍打磨肉体、锻炼精神，踏入仙途依旧难如登天。
按照学校里的仙师所言，他这样修炼，大概再炼三四十年，才有微渺的机会在六十岁气血衰败之前，尝试一次踏入仙途的突破。
失败了，便是暴毙当场。
前途渺茫，大学毕业之后，陆羽本来都准备找个普通人的工作，像上一世一样安安稳稳过完余生。
可前些日子的一场变故，让他终究没法安度余生，只能舍弃安稳，冒险来参加帝国地仙管理局最近新推出的地仙速成法。

搏一搏，以普通人之资，踏入地仙道途的机会。
而现在，老天似乎都在眷顾他，仅是一次速成地仙法手术，陆羽就幸运地成功了。
想到这些，他的嘴角都止不住地上扬，要不是旁边还有人，他早就放声大笑出来。
不过，还未等陆羽庆祝，手术台旁的秃顶中年人便打断了他，认真指导：
“你在学校应该也学过观想静心的功夫，现在按照我的指引，摒弃杂念，内观自身，引导心神沉入丹田之中！”
陆羽强压下翻涌的狂喜，连忙依言照做。
他在大学里修过基础观想法，静心是其中主要一环。
陆羽虽然功夫不深，未得三昧，但此刻心神一沉，也立刻进入了状态。
摒弃杂念，闭目内视。
下一刻，陆羽清晰地“看见”，在自己小腹、脐下三寸的位置，一团温润如暖玉、厚重如大地的淡黄光团静静悬浮，内里是一块三尺方圆的荒芜土地。
这块土地，如同陆羽的第二个心脏，呼吸吐纳着他浑身的精气神。
吸时如倦鸟归巢，海纳百川；
呼时如灵泉喷涌，流遍周身。
一吸一呼之间，陆羽的精气神被这块土地不断淬炼，力量从四肢百骸中缓缓涌现。
一时之功，竟顶他平时修炼数日。
这块神奇的土地，便是地仙道的根基。
道土！
“感受到了？”
秃顶男人抱着胳膊，语气平淡：
content_en:
March, 631 years of the New Calendar.
Longshucheng, First People's Hospital.
Operating room.
"It's so uncomfortable!"
My head was dizzy, as if I had drunk too much fake wine.
He opened his eyes drowsily, and the face of a bald man wearing gold-rimmed glasses roughly came into view.
"Young man, congratulations! The quick Earth Immortal Technique surgery performed on you was very successful. You survived the troublesome fusion stage. Now you are a rookie monk who has entered the Earth Immortal Way!"
The corners of the bald man's mouth were slightly raised, and his tone was somewhat relaxed.
After successfully completing an operation and receiving the operation fee, he was in a very happy mood.
"Quick fix, Earth Immortal, successful..."
Lu Yu, who had just woken up, muttered these words in confusion. As he spoke, his confused eyes slowly lit up brightly.
"I, Master Dao, I am done!"
Joy surged into his heart, his mind gradually cleared up, and Lu Yu remembered everything before.
In his previous life, Lu Yu was an ordinary person. During a good deed to save someone, he was crushed into pieces by a passing dump truck.
With the memories of his previous life, he was reincarnated into this extraordinary world where he could cultivate immortality. He was considered a time traveler.
After reliving for twenty-four years, because he has no talent for cultivating immortals, even if he studies hard every day to polish his body and temper his spirit, it is still difficult to enter the immortal path.
According to what the immortal master in the school said, if he practices like this for another thirty or forty years, he will have a slim chance of making a breakthrough on the path to immortality before his energy and blood decline at the age of sixty.
If you fail, you will die suddenly on the spot.
The future was bleak. After graduating from college, Lu Yu was originally planning to find a job as an ordinary person and live the rest of his life as peacefully as in his previous life.
But an incident happened a few days ago, and he was unable to live out the rest of his life peacefully. He could only give up his stability and take the risk to participate in the new Earth Immortal Quick Method recently launched by the Empire's Earth Immortal Administration.
Take a chance and get the chance to enter the path of earthly immortality with ordinary people's resources.
But now, God seems to be favoring him. Lu Yu was lucky enough to succeed with just one quick Earth Immortal Surgery.
Thinking of this, the corners of his mouth couldn't help but raise. If there weren't people around him, he would have burst out laughing.
However, before Lu Yu could celebrate, the bald middle-aged man next to the operating table interrupted him and gave him serious instructions:
"You should have also learned the art of visualization and meditation in school. Now follow my guidance, abandon distracting thoughts, look inside yourself, and guide your mind to sink into your Dantian!"
Lu Yu suppressed the surge of ecstasy and quickly followed the instructions.
He studied basic meditation in college, of which meditation is an important part.
Although Lu Yu's kung fu was not deep and he had not yet achieved Samadhi, his mind sank at this moment and he immediately entered the state.
Get rid of distracting thoughts, close your eyes and look inward.
The next moment, Lu Yu clearly "saw" that in his lower abdomen and three inches below his navel, a ball of pale yellow light, as warm as warm jade and as thick as the earth, was quietly suspended. Inside was a three-foot-square barren land.
This land was like Lu Yu's second heart, breathing in all his energy.
When you breathe in, you are like a tired bird returning to its nest, embracing all kinds of rivers;
When you exhale, it is like a spiritual spring gushing out, flowing all over your body.
Between inhalations and exhalations, Lu Yu's energy and spirit were continuously tempered by this land, and power slowly emerged from his limbs and bones.
The result he achieved in one moment was actually more than he could practice for several days on a regular basis.
This magical land is the foundation of the Earth Immortal Way.
Daotu!
"Feel it?"
The bald man crossed his arms and spoke calmly:
